about: Everyday-language versions of the benchmark requests (eval/cases.json): the same parts, phrased the way someone without CAD vocabulary might ask, mostly by purpose. Used with `python -m eval.retrieval --queries casual` and the same relevance labels, to test whether meaning-based retrieval helps when requests don't share the library's words. Drafted by Claude (who also wrote the library and keywords, so some phrasing may still leak); 'reviewed' says whether a human has checked and edited them.

queries.s01: I need a little tube to hold a 6mm bolt about one pinkie finger width off the wall.
queries.s02: A 25mm cube I can thread onto a 10mm rod.
queries.s03: A six-sided chunk like a fat pencil cross-section, 30mm wide and 8mm thick.
queries.s04: A flat bar about 70 by 20 with a long cutout down the middle, so a bolt can slide along it to adjust things.
queries.s05: Something shaped like a little traffic cone, 40mm across the bottom and 30mm high, solid.
queries.m01: A backing plate to mount a circuit board on, 120 by 80, with six screw holes in two rows and soft corners.
queries.m02: A tray for sorting screws, about 100 by 60 and 15 deep, split into two sections.
queries.m03: A cap to put on a volume-control shaft, 30mm round; the shaft has one flat side.
queries.m04: A round plate 60mm across with a big hole in the middle and eight small screw holes around it.
queries.m05: Something to keep six cables lined up neatly along the edge of my desk.
queries.m06: A long open trough, 100mm long, 30 wide and 20 tall, open on top and at both ends, for routing wires.
queries.m07: A cup about 50mm wide and 60 tall with a smooth rounded edge at the bottom.
queries.m08: A ring that clips around a 32mm pipe, with a small gap so it can flex open.
queries.h01: A cog with 20 teeth that fits on a 5mm shaft.
queries.h02: Something to prop my phone up on the desk at a comfortable angle while I watch videos.
queries.h03: A thing I can screw to the wall to hang my headphones on.
queries.p01: Make me a 15cm ruler that says ALEX on it.
queries.p02: A dice with pictures of snakes and ladders instead of dots.
queries.p03: A little kitty sitting up in a tree.
